t: You're standing at numbers 1 and 3 Graham Terrace, in Westminster. This is where Nancy Mitford was born, in 1904. She grew up to be an English novelist, biographer and journalist, and was counted among the bright young things of London's inter-war social scene. Her novels deal with upper-class life in England and France, and she is considered a sharp and often provocative wit. She also wrote popular historical biographies.
